sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Manual / Functional Test Engineer== with 6+ years of hands-on experience ==analysing business and functional requirements to design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases and test plans==. ==Executes functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, system and UAT== across web and enterprise applications, and performs ==exploratory testing== to uncover edge cases. ==Validates REST APIs and backend responses using Postman== and performs ==basic backend and data validation using SQL==. ==Logs, tracks and manages defects through their full lifecycle in Jira== and Azure DevOps, ==maintains the Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM)==, and ==participates actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies==. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking and defect-reporting clarity with excellent cross-functional communication.
